sources.hostsNote: hosts left OUT on purpose (empty means no limit): the stream hosts rotate and differ per server (gzip.rousav.tech, stream.vidbolt.xyz, proxy.vidbolt.xyz, dash-hls-bridge.johndoesdmc.workers.dev, v.vidozen.xyz, sandyowl17.boats). The code itself requests only kissbae.com, vidozen.xyz and vidbolt.pro. The test script warns 'no hosts list'.

sources.name: Anistream
sources.hostsNote: no hosts list on purpose. The extension itself requests only graphql.animex.one and api.anistream.one, but the stream and subtitle hosts it hands to the player belong to several providers and change (fetch.nexabloom.top, *.mysubsplay.com, s-NN.megavid.se, hls.dramahot.top, hls.krussdomi.com, subst.krussdomi.com, spr-cdn.echovideo.to); if the orchestrator knows the apps only check hosts on the extension's own requests, ["graphql.animex.one", "api.anistream.one"] is the complete list. The guide test only warns when it is empty.
